fields.title: Automate vendor invoice reconciliation against purchase orders
fields.problem_statement: Vendor invoices arrive as emails and PDFs and are reconciled against purchase orders by hand; about 6 hours per batch, around 3,000 invoices per month.
fields.current_workflow: Every morning export the PO list from SAP to Excel, copy each invoice total and PO number into the spreadsheet, flag mismatches, re-key what the scanner misses.
fields.pain_points: Tedious; re-keying what the scanner misses; invoice formats differ by vendor so the columns never line up; month-end weekends.
fields.volume_or_frequency: Around 3,000 invoices per month; every day; month-end peaks
fields.data_shape: PO table schema is stable; invoices are unstructured PDFs and the occasional CSV; formats differ by vendor
fields.what_was_tried: An OCR add-on two years ago
fields.why_it_failed: It reads the numbers but not the context, so mismatch decisions stayed manual; nobody trusted the extracted totals without checking.
fields.constraints: Cannot store vendor bank details outside the tenant; auto-approval must stay below the audit threshold with a full audit trail.
fields.success_criteria: Match 90% of invoices automatically; hand the analyst a short exception list with reasons; cut 6 hours to 1.
fields.adoption_risk: Skeptical after the OCR tool; wants exceptions with the reason and a one-click fix; training would help.
fields.security_or_data_use: Vendor bank details must stay inside the tenant; full audit trail required.
fields.timeline: Before the fiscal year-end close in 10 weeks
fields.open_questions: Whether the auditors accept machine-matched invoices below a threshold.
